# integrate testit

Adopt the author's own `testit` (a Go test runner/formatter from the kamilsk toolbelt) in the Go toolset and drop the two tools it replaces, `gotest` ([[DOT-100]]) and `panicparse` ([[DOT-109]]), added a fortnight earlier.
